table_html:
• Strongest motion at t = 5.80 s: mean speed 0.44 px/frame (13 px/s), 11% of pixels above 1 px/frame.
  • 49% of the frames contain motion (more than 2% of pixels moving); the other 51% are essentially still.
  • Dominant direction of motion on screen: up (~105 deg, 38% of all flow magnitude falls in that 10-degree bin).
  • The global (camera) translation is tiny - median 0.03 px/frame, above 0.3 px/frame in only 0% of frames - so the camera is basically still and the flow comes from objects moving in the scene (on average 2.8% of pixels move independently).
  • Divergence stays near zero (median -0.0001/frame), so there is no sustained zoom or forward/backward camera motion.
